messages.subject: Re: ggplot2: plot time hourly by day of the week
parts:
The Lubridate package is great for this.

Not sure if you wanted just hours, but you can change the `units` in the `round_date` function to almost anything you want ("15 minutes", "2 hours", etc)

--pete
----

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

foo_plt <- foo %>%
  mutate(mis_horas = round_date(horas, unit = "hours"),
             mis_horas = round(hour(mis_horas) + minute(mis_horas) / 60, 3)) %>%
  group_by(mis_horas) %>%
  summarise(horas_cnt = sum(conteo))
    
ggplot(data=foo_plt, aes(x=mis_horas,y=horas_cnt)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth()
